content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the misuse of the unsigned long type for the 'total_cycles' variable in the sh_cmt_channel structure, which is intended to hold total cycle counts that can exceed the 32-bit range on 32-bit machines. This led to the clocksource mask being incorrectly limited to 32-bits, resulting in potential overflow and inaccurate timekeeping on 32-bit systems. The solution involved changing total_cycles to a 64-bit type (u64) and updating the clocksource mask to reflect 64-bit capabilities, ensuring proper functionality across different architectures.
